# Servo CAD references (downloaded 2026-11-07)

| file | what | source |
|---|---|---|
| ws-2d/ST3215.pdf, ws-2d/ST3215.dxf | 2D outline drawing (Feetech "SCS215" case) | https://files.waveshare.com/upload/0/08/ST3215-2D.zip (Waveshare wiki "ST3215 Servo") |
| ws-3d/ST3215.step | 3D model, mm | https://files.waveshare.com/upload/5/59/ST3215-3D.zip |
| ST3215_Servo_User_Manual.pdf | manual (specs, wiring) | https://files.waveshare.com/upload/f/f4/ST3215_Servo_User_Manual.pdf |
| STS3215_03a_SO100.step | STS3215 model used by the SO-100 arm, mm | https://github.com/TheRobotStudio/SO-ARM100 (STEP/SO100) |

Waveshare's ST3215 is the Feetech STS3215 case. The STS3250 is listed by resellers with the same outline
(45.22 x 24.72 x 35 mm, 74.5 g vs 55 g, 25T spline); no official STS3250 drawing found. Measure both on arrival
before printing anything that clamps them.

Key numbers from the drawing (mm): body 45.22 x 24.72, height 32 (35 incl. output boss, 37.25 with both horns);
output axis 10.11 from the near end; horn disc d19.2 with 4 holes on a d14 circle.
